author: The Q
description:
AWOL Vision LuxVision brings a new approach to ultra-short-throw home cinema. At IFA 2026, I tested its 150-inch setup, 4K 120Hz performance, 6,000 ISO lumens and, most importantly, its lossless vertical Optical Lens Shift. I also checked the different design options and how LuxVision performs in bright and dark environments.

Interested in LuxVision like I am? It officially launches in October with a special launch offer.
👉 AWOL LuxVision: https://bit.ly/4zJZLy9
title: A Revolution in the World of Projectors? AWOL LuxVision at IFA 2026

author: The Q
description:
I thought I had already found the right dehumidifier - until I actually measured the humidity.

👉 Check the Gasbye DryPrime 50 on Amazon:
 https://www.amazon.com/Gasbye-Dehumidifier-Basement-Powerful-Auto-restart/dp/B0CXML5P2M?maas=maas_adg_A65627D926B0258C8A8FD5EFBE6932AD_afap_abs&ref_=aa_maas&tag=maas

Our office was sitting at around 70% relative humidity, so I bought one of Amazon’s best-selling dehumidifiers and ran it for several days. The result was disappointing. That made me curious about what those “50, 80, or 100+ pints per day” claims actually mean.

For this video, I tested the Gasbye DryPrime 50 Dehumidifier using real measurements, testing it both in my office and at home. I tracked humidity and water collected, checked the ENERGY STAR rating, and even opened both machines to see what’s happening inside.

The DryPrime 50 is ENERGY STAR-certified and rated for up to 50 pints per day under standardized DOE conditions. I also looked at details like its anti-corrosion evapo
title: The Ultimate Humidity Killer? Gasbye DryPrime 50 Teardown Review
